title: A performance enhancement of the Payne-Hanek range reduction algorithm
summary: Range reduction plays a crucial role in the accuracy and performance of evaluating trigonometric functions, and is often the primary bottleneck for large floating-point inputs. While fast algorithms such as Cody--Waite work efficiently over narrow intervals, the Payne--Hanek algorithm remains the standard technique for accurate reduction across large floating-point inputs. However, many existing implementations of Payne--Hanek suffer from high latency due to heavy branching, conversion overheads, and the use of multi-word integer arithmetic, which hinders SIMD vectorization.
